name: Admin - User and role management
description: Verifies the admin panel: user CRUD, role assignment, audit log, and system settings

planSteps.description: Log in as 'gerente' (admin) and navigate to /dashboard/admin/users
Assert that users list shows all registered users with columns: name, email, role, status, last login
Click 'New User' and fill in: name, email, password, select role from dropdown (gerente, residente, HES, supervisor, operador, tecnico, administrativo, cliente)
Submit and verify the new user appears in the list with correct role badge
Click on a user to edit their profile and change their role
Assert that the role change is reflected immediately
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/audit to view the audit trail
Assert that recent admin actions (user creation, role changes) are recorded in the audit log
Navigate to /dashboard/admin/settings and modify a system setting
Verify that settings changes persist after page reload
